source: live browser — window.__SIM.state.kpis sampled at two ticks at http://localhost:8000/index.html
scenario: KPI strip jumps (T11 DoD + mandatory check #4)
rootCause: app.js emitted skeleton lifecycle events + called recomputeKpis() each tick, but no subscriber folded those events back into lot.status, so every lot kept an undefined status (counted as WIP forever) and kpis were frozen at {wip:100,throughput:0,yield:100,mtbf:2400,oee:100}.
fix: app.js now subscribes 'lot-lifecycle' on the dispatcher: lot.start/step.transition -> status 'running', material.in_transit -> 'in_process', lot.complete -> 'complete'. recomputeKpis() then sees lots transition and produces moving values.
